_note: Menu paths change between app versions. Update 'verified_on' whenever you re-check an item against the live app.
page_note: A Facebook Page needs a personal Facebook profile behind it, so expect to create the Page from your own profile. That's normal: only the Page represents the persona.

items.title: Deny contact sync
items.detail: Whenever an app asks to "find friends from your contacts" or sync your address book, say no. On every platform, during signup and again in settings afterwards.

items.title: Don't connect your personal accounts
items.detail: Never link your own Facebook, Instagram or Google account to the persona's accounts. If an app offers to connect an account it found on the phone, decline.

items.title: Turn off account suggestions
items.detail: Turn off "suggest this account to others" style settings. TikTok: Settings → Privacy → Suggest your account to others (every toggle off). Instagram: Settings → Account privacy area.

items.title: One email per persona
items.detail: Each persona's accounts use their own email address. Never your personal one, and never shared between personas.

items.title: DO link Instagram to the persona's Facebook Page
items.detail: This one is wanted: connect the persona's Instagram (professional account) to the persona's own Facebook Page. It's needed for cross-posting. Only ever to the persona's Page, never to anything personal.
